items.name: Claude Code
items.how: The strategist: it thinks about the big picture and plans the next move while I nod wisely.

items.name: Cline
items.how: The muscle-bound builder inside VS Code: hunts through folders, edits files and tidies up the mess while I supervise.

items.name: Cursor
items.how: Still on a first date with it, mostly to see if it keeps a project's context tidy.

items.name: 9Router
items.how: One endpoint that keeps Cline running on many models, completely free, so I get more done without watching the meter.

items.name: VS Code
items.how: Where I edit code and config files.

items.name: Astro
items.how: Builds the pages of this site from Markdown files, one small page at a time.

items.name: Obsidian
items.how: Home of my vault: thousands of notes, tagged, linked and only slightly overgrown.

items.name: Quartz
items.how: Turns part of the vault into 2ndbrain, so my second brain gets a front door.

items.name: Eleventy
items.how: Waters the Digital Garden: plain files go in, tidy pages come out.

items.name: n8n
items.how: Self-hosted on a VPS with Docker, quietly doing the chores while I pretend to be productive.

items.name: Google Cloud
items.how: The cloud I visit when my laptop needs a break.

items.name: VM
items.how: A small always-on machine that keeps the workflows awake.
items.source: user list ('VM'); assumed to be the VPS/GCP VM

items.name: ClickUp
items.how: Where my tasks live; n8n keeps it in sync so I do not have to copy things by hand.

items.name: Tailscale
items.how: Digs a private tunnel so my Obsidian plugin can talk straight to n8n on the VPS, no public doors left ajar.

items.name: Bitwarden
items.how: Keeps my everyday passwords, so my brain can stay busy with more important things, like noodles.

items.name: KeePassXC
items.how: The offline backup vault for client IDs, API tokens, PATs and other secrets.

items.name: Vercel
items.how: Ships my small apps with one push and no ceremony.

items.name: Netlify
items.how: Ships the projects dashboard and its little functions, so the heatmap can bloom.

items.name: GitHub Pages
items.how: Hosts this site, a no-fuss home for pages that just want to exist.

items.name: Namecheap
items.how: Where I bought haphan.digital, the address of the whole garden.

items.name: Supabase
items.how: My pick for the backend when a small app needs a database.

items.name: Lovable
items.how: Where I sketch a first version of an interface before refining it.

items.name: Nói ra chữ
items.how: Dictate Vietnamese and paste the text anywhere.
items.source: speech-to-text repo (kept from v1, not in new list)

items.name: Project dashboard
items.how: Turns my project notes into progress bars and an activity heatmap.
items.source: projects repo (kept from v1, not in new list)
